parsed.rationale: Three distinct enum types — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — all in the `Wallpaper` package each carry an identically-shaped `blendMode` computed property at exactly line 62 of their respective files, flagged as `function-duplicates-exact`. Because all three records share the same package and none carry any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), the duplication is unambiguously accidental. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a `BlendModeConvertible` protocol with a `blendMode` computed-property requirement, provide a single default implementation in a protocol extension, and remove the three redundant per-type implementations. A new file `BlendModeConvertible.swift` in the same `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/` directory keeps the change local to the `Wallpaper` package.
